title: b7z9.25.a: overlap-window arithmetic (R-02a-040) - py slot_coordination + rust multi_instance
description: Child of b7z9.25 (spec 02a 2a.5.3, R-02a-040): the overlap window = beacons within setup_window + occupied_time + guard window - the window arithmetic is ABSENT in all languages. Python: python/src/lichen/link/slot_coordination.py:303-357 (MultiRootState window is caller-scoped); Rust: rust/lichen-rpl/src/multi_instance.rs:1033-1103. Implement the combined-window overlap check in both, mirroring the C (b7z9.12/.24 track C), with unit tests per language. Vectors per the all-implementations rule if the overlap decision is observable on wire.
